Definition: from a derivative of G5316; to make apparent, i.e. (passively) to appear (neuter participle as noun, a spectacle):--sight.
BiblicalUsage: Phantazo means to make apparent, to appear, and it appears once, at the mountain that burned. The sight was so terrible that Moses said he exceedingly feared and quaked, and the word for that dreadful sight is the thing shown, the appearance itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mountain's terror is the measure of God's holiness: even Moses, the friend of God, trembled at the sight of it.
